faq_heading: New construction in Fraser Heights: your questions answered

faq.q: What have houses in Fraser Heights sold for?
faq.a: 82 houses sold in Fraser Heights at a median of $1,559,000, with the middle half between $1,380,000 and $1,727,500.

faq.q: How long do homes take to sell in Fraser Heights?
faq.a: In Fraser Heights, townhomes were quickest at 18 days at a median, and houses slowest at 28 days.

faq.q: Which homes in Fraser Heights are the newest?
faq.a: Of the homes that resold in Fraser Heights, townhomes had the newest median build year, 2025.

blocks.text: The search above lists active MLS® listings in Fraser Heights where the board's age field reads 0 or less: homes finished this year, and homes listed ahead of completion. Houses, townhomes and condos are in; land and income properties are not. Over November 2025 to October 2026, the busiest home type in Fraser Heights was houses: 82 sales at a median of $1,559,000, and 2 types had 5 or more sales.

items.t: Fraser Heights: 82 houses sold at a median of $1,559,000, with the middle half between $1,380,000 and $1,727,500. The median house took 28 days to sell and closed at 95.7% of list.

23 townhomes sold in Fraser Heights at a median of $925,000 (middle half $899,900 to $1,029,500). A typical townhome in Fraser Heights spent 18 days on the market and closed at 100.0% of the asking price.

blocks.text: 3 Condos also sold in Fraser Heights, too few for a median to mean anything, so no price is shown for them.
Source: Paragon closed sales, November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026; medians need 5 or more sales.
How Fraser Heights compares with the rest of North Surrey

items.t: Houses in Fraser Heights have the highest median of the 7 North Surrey sub-areas, $1,559,000, ahead of Whalley at $1,305,000; the lowest is Bridgeview at $1,040,000.
Townhomes in Fraser Heights have the highest median of the 5 North Surrey sub-areas, $925,000, ahead of Bridgeview at $855,000; the lowest is Whalley at $620,000.

blocks.text: By build year, townhomes are the newest homes selling in Fraser Heights (median 2025) and houses the oldest (median 1996), a gap of 29 years.
